description: This file defines the class DefaultBackOffConfig, which implements the BackOffConfig interface. It provides configuration related to backoff mechanisms, including loading settings from a Config object and exposing a TimeoutConfig. The class is marked immutable and final, with overridden methods for equality, string representation, and hash code.
